title: R5 (optional): T19 S_full theorem-domain reachability at a larger calibration allocation

supersedes.what_changes: a new fixed larger calibration-size grid for the S_full arm only, including the old anchor and values around/beyond the approximately 2.7-million-sample extrapolation; the old protocol's rule forbids enlarging m after the fact, so this is a new labelled reachability extension

provenance.observed_before_design: the September T19-S finding that S_full did not reach eta <= 0.1 at the allocated m (median eta 0.454 at 131,072 and 0.226 at 524,288) was observed before this protocol was written; the extrapolation is not a guarantee
provenance.source_change_recorded: bounded-memory covariance accumulation (covariance.py), checked against direct construction on small fixtures

question: At what calibration size m does the independent full sample covariance S_full reach the theorem domain eta <= 0.1 on G1, and does every in-domain realisation satisfy the unchanged 44 eta^2 remainder bound with first-order projector agreement?

hypotheses.H1_reachability: the eta distribution and the fraction of realisations reaching eta <= 0.1 are reported at every m; 'not reachable' at the largest m is a valid result
hypotheses.H2_conditional_bound: every in-domain realisation satisfies ||P_hat - P - delta P||_op <= 44 eta^2; a violation inside eta <= 0.1 is evidence against the constant on G1 and is reported as such
hypotheses.H3_first_order: the first-order projector-norm ratio is reported for in-domain realisations
hypotheses.H4_scaling: the fitted median-eta-versus-m slope is reported beside the archived m^(-1/2) extrapolation
hypotheses.H5_integrity: no realisation is discarded or redrawn, including out-of-domain ones; the calibration and training draws are independent

independent_unit: one independent calibration draw of m noise samples and one independent training draw; seeds are independent across realisations

estimands.primary: P(eta <= 0.1) for the S_full estimator at each fixed m
estimands.secondary: the conditional in-domain remainder/eta^2 and the first-order projector-norm ratio

streaming_matches_direct.checks: the bounded-memory covariance equals the direct construction on a small fixture

nested_arms_are_prefixes.checks: nested m arms are prefixes of one stream

out_of_domain_retained.checks: out-of-domain realisations are retained in the summary

inference.covariance_positivity: lambda_min(I+E) > 0 is required for a domain classification; non-positive realisations are labelled indefinite and retained
inference.g1: the frozen generator G1 at d = 256, rank 2; S_full only
inference.multiplicity: none claimed; each m is reported

stopping_rule: fixed allocation: 4 production calibration sizes x 20 independent seeds = 80 fits; the run stops when the enumerated cells complete

failure_interpretation.not_reachable: no m reaches eta <= 0.1; reported as the predeclared finding, not as a reason to enlarge m after the fact
failure_interpretation.in_domain_violation: a violation inside the theorem domain is evidence against the stated constant on G1 and is reported by (m, eta, lambda_min, remainder/eta^2)
failure_interpretation.indefinite_covariance: realisations with lambda_min(I+E) <= 0 are labelled indefinite and retained; they are not in-domain

budget.retry_policy: failed cells are charged and retried only by an explicit --allow-repeat

explicitly_not_claimed: an extension of the 44 eta^2 bound beyond eta <= 0.1
that passing the in-domain check proves the proposition; it is a necessary consistency check on one generator
that the extrapolated calibration size guarantees every realisation enters the domain
any change to the archived T19 registered prediction (still NOT met)
any scientific result from fixture (development) runs
